request.user:
Change c0384. Location: 1818 Vol. III, Ch. III; 1831 Ch. XX.

Context before (unchanged): I confess that I felt a few sensations of terror.

1818 text: I had no compass with me, and was so little acquainted with the geography of this part of the world that the sun was of little benefit to me.

1831 text: I had no compass with me, and was so slenderly acquainted with the geography of this part of the world, that the sun was of little benefit to me.

Diff: I had no compass with me, and was so [-little-] {+slenderly+} acquainted with the geography of this part of the world {+,+} that the sun was of little benefit to me.

Context after (unchanged): I might be driven into the wide Atlantic, and feel all the tortures of starvation, or be swallowed up in the immeasurable waters that roared and buffeted around me.

result.rationale: Swaps 'little' for 'slenderly' and adds a comma; the meaning of acquaintance with geography is unchanged. A stylistic diction shift with no interpretive consequence.
